agent_notes: Government listing confirmed on all four supplied 2025 NIRF pages: Malwanchal University is shown in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification failed with the exact managed-proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs to the expected NIRF, search and official hosts then used curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.
The current malwanchaluniversity.in site links to legacy malwanchaluniversity.com and constituent-site domains; only malwanchaluniversity.in pages and PDFs were used as official evidence.

The catalogue is partial and internally inconsistent: the main Courses, Contact, Programs, institution/school, IIBRS, certificate and programme-PDF sources expose overlapping but non-identical lists. The older fellowship landing page still shows a January 2023 registration deadline, while a separate 2026 fellowship PDF is linked from Programs. Active scope and reconciliation of umbrella versus specialized entries require manual review.
Exact strings such as PEADIATRICS, CARDIOTHORASIC, TRASFUSION and Beside Assistant (Ward Boy) are retained as displayed by the official pages or PDF.
